description: Search Austria's Herold.at directory by keyword or category and region, or paste Herold.at search/profile URLs. Collect full business profiles, contacts, opening hours, ratings and every published review without cookies.

businessUrls.description: Direct Herold.at business profile links, e.g. https://www.herold.at/gelbe-seiten/wien/3M7DR/ar-all-round-installationen-gmbh/. Use the sourceUrl field from search results. Used in urls, detail and reviews modes.
businessUrls.title: Business profile URLs

includeDetails.description: In search and urls modes, also open every business profile for full address, coordinates, weekday hours, all phone numbers, social links, services, company register data and reviews. Adds one request per business.
includeDetails.title: Open each business profile

includeReviews.description: Attach recent reviews to business records when a profile is opened. Use reviews mode to export every review as an individual row.
includeReviews.title: Include customer reviews

locations.description: Austrian federal state, city, district or 4-digit postal code, e.g. Wien, Salzburg, Graz-Stadt, Kärnten, 1160. Leave empty for nationwide results. Used in search mode.
locations.title: Locations

maxItems.description: Hard cap on dataset rows. In reviews mode each row is one review; in other modes each row is one business.
maxItems.title: Max records

maxPages.description: Stop after this many result pages for each keyword/location pair or pasted search URL. 0 means follow Herold's pagination to the end or until maxItems is reached.
maxPages.title: Max result pages per search

maxReviews.description: How many reviews to attach to each business record, or how many to export per business in reviews mode. 0 means all published reviews.
maxReviews.title: Max reviews per business

minRating.description: Keep only businesses rated at least this many stars. 0 disables the filter. Businesses without a rating are excluded when this is above 0.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

mode.description: Search by keyword/category, paste search or profile URLs, fetch full business profiles, or export every review as its own row.
mode.title: What to scrape

onlyVerified.description: Keep only businesses whose Herold listing carries the Verifiziert badge.
onlyVerified.title: Only verified listings

openedNow.description: Use Herold's live opening-hours filter so only businesses currently open are returned. Also filters pasted URLs and profile records locally.
openedNow.title: Only businesses open right now

requireEmail.description: Keep only listings that publish an email address.
requireEmail.title: Only businesses with an email

requirePhone.description: Keep only listings that publish a phone number.
requirePhone.title: Only businesses with a phone number

requireWebsite.description: Keep only listings that publish their own website.
requireWebsite.title: Only businesses with a website

searchTerms.description: Business type, trade, product or keyword, e.g. Installateur, Zahnarzt, Restaurant, Photovoltaik. Each term is searched in every location; leave locations empty to search all of Austria. Used in search mode.
searchTerms.title: Keywords or categories

searchUrls.description: Paste Herold.at result pages, keyword search URLs, A-Z directory pages or business profile links. Result pages paginate automatically. Used in urls mode.
searchUrls.title: Herold.at search or profile URLs

title: Herold.at Business Directory & Reviews Input
